comparison.objective: Fill and set down a cup at a sprung soda lever; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a cup aligned under a nozzle while sustaining lever force and stop at a visually controlled fill level, versus fine tool/collar handling and iterative impact evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Liquid must finish 0.5–2 cm below the rim with no overflow, spill, or >30-degree tip and the cup upright; candidate requires two bounded dynamic stops and retained setting.
comparison.reason: Sustained contact and fill-level control are different tested abilities from mechanical commissioning.
